fact: Law no. 2008-08 of 25 January 2008 on electronic transactions, adopted by the National Assembly on 30 November 2007, gives electronic records and signatures equivalence with paper and sets rules for electronic commerce, in Senegal.
system: Loi n° 2008-08 sur les transactions électroniques

fact: Decree no. 2008-718 of 30 June 2008 on electronic commerce, made to apply law no. 2008-08, sets supplier information duties, contractual liability, electronic advertising and electronic contract rules in Senegal.
system: Décret n° 2008-718 relatif au commerce électronique

fact: The justice minister said Senegal has a legal framework including the law on electronic transactions, which recognises the legal value of digital documents.
